subject: Senior ML Infra (L5) — comp band alignment & approval request
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed offer for Alex Romero (L5) — base/bonus/equity

Hi Marissa / Stephanie,

We completed the final loop with Alex (ex-Acme AI). He's excited about the role and has one competing verbal offer with a faster start date. Below is the proposed standard offer that recruiting recommends within our published band:

- Base salary: $180,000
- Target bonus: 10% (annual)
- Equity: 0.50% RSU (4-year vest, 1y cliff)
- Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time)

Alex is a solid match for the ML infra team and flagged interest in a slightly higher equity percentage. Recruiting thinks a modest increase to equity or base will materially impact acceptance given the competing offer.

Attachments: ACME_MLInfra_Offer_20260609.pdf (draft offer), comp_band_playbook_2026.pdf (band reference)

Ask: Can you confirm approval to extend the above, or if we should propose: base $185k OR equity 0.65%?

Thanks,
Soojin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed offer for Alex Romero (L5) — comp band alignment & approval request

Markus / Laura — quick request for comp sanity check. Candidate is L5 (Senior ML Infra). Recruiting proposed base $180k, 10% bonus, 0.50% equity + $20k sign-on. Given his background (production infra + model caching experience) I'd like to bump to $185k base OR 0.65% equity to make the package more competitive. Which lever is easier from compensation's POV and still consistent with band?

If we need an exception, can we route to Vivek for sign-off? We need to get this out today — Alex is leaning to accept if we move quickly.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Eng Manager, ML Infra | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed offer for Alex Romero (L5) — comp band alignment & approval request

Marissa —

Thanks for the detail. Per the current L5 band (live in the comp playbook attached), the midpoint sits around $170–195k base. Both levers are feasible:

- Base: $185k is still within band and can be approved by comp (no exec exception required).
- Equity: 0.65% is slightly above typical midpoint for L5 but still manageable if we re-allocate some of the equity budget for the role.

My recommendation: approve $185k base + 12% target bonus + 0.60% equity. The small bonus increase helps long-term retention and keeps cash competitive without stretching equity budgets. If you prefer the equity bump to 0.65% instead of base bump, I can scope that, but it will require a quick check on total grant pool for the org.

I can approve this formally — looping Vivek only if Marissa wants an exception beyond 0.65% or sign-on > $25k.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Compensation Partner | Redwood Inference

Marissa: please proceed with the verbal and send the draft offer via DocuSign. Capture a note in the candidate file that we approved a slightly elevated bonus (15%) to align with market. No exec exception required.
